description: Verifies the Hulse-Taylor binary pulsar: the Peters-Mathews orbital period derivative agrees with the observed value, the post-Newtonian system of the pulsar is built with two bodies and a positive gravitational wave luminosity, and the adaptive integrator advances it.

checks.label: the analytical period derivative agrees with the observed value within 1 percent
the pulsar system contains exactly two bodies
the initial gravitational wave luminosity is positive
the integrator recorded at least one step
